tasks.title: Define passive trusted capability and scheduler execution contracts
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: Deliver passive immutable versioned trusted application capability/trigger/job/form descriptions and optional scheduler/resource eligibility ports, including input/result/event/execution/recovery/checkpoint contracts, exact worker build and identity-binding references, detached run settings, supported finite operations/hints and all selected RM10 defaults/bounds. Keep logical trusted definitions separate from observed per-instance participation and from Management API endpoint capabilities. Existing binding constructors/unmanaged consumers/independent backends remain compatible; unknown kinds/contracts remain unavailable. Presence cannot install schema, schema cannot load code, and capture performs no handlers/provider I/O. This owns the passive contract slice of RM09-AC01, RM09-AC04, RM09-AC05, RM09-AC07, RM09-AC16, RM09-AC20 and RM10-AC01, RM10-AC02, RM10-AC03, RM10-AC12, RM10-AC24, RM10-AC27, RM10-AC29, RM10-AC32, RM10-AC36, RM10-AC39, RM10-AC40.
tasks.validation: Run focused passive binding/public contract unit cases for exact identity, version conflicts, required fields, supported operations and forbidden executable hints; check no handler/network resolution and existing API compatibility. Document trusted owner/observations, captured identity/contract and finite form semantics; include proportionate independent review. This initial unstarted split still has generated inherited dependencies; the controller must refine its concrete prerequisite/ownership validation through the supported child update before activating implementation.

tasks.title: Implement compatible CSharp TypeScript scheduler codecs clients and public substitutes
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: Implement the agreed trusted descriptor/scheduler/eligibility/cohort portable wire and CSharp/TypeScript client interfaces, explicit native REST aliases/codecs and useful public CommonTesting substitutes. Preserve closed command validation, exact case-sensitive IDs, decimalInt64/revisions, UTC timestamps, combined body/envelope/depth limits, unknown-safe response interpretation and old protocol support. Optional companions avoid compulsory new members on independent backends/substitutes. Retain existing transport deadline/cancellation/actual cleanup and no automatic writes; no new SDK transport or framework. This owns portable contract/consumer portions of RM09-AC04, RM09-AC05, RM09-AC08, RM09-AC09, RM09-AC10, RM09-AC16, RM09-AC17, RM09-AC19, RM09-AC20 and RM10-AC08, RM10-AC24, RM10-AC25, RM10-AC28, RM10-AC32, RM10-AC36, RM10-AC39, RM10-AC40.
tasks.validation: Run cross-language exact wire/conformance and old-client/substitute cases with large counters, unknown fields/statuses, strict commands, forbidden hints and complete encoded-byte/depth admission. Check public API/codec/alias registration and consumer documentation; include proportionate independent review. Native service semantics are proved by their implementation owners. This initial unstarted split still has generated inherited dependencies; the controller must refine its concrete prerequisite/ownership validation through the supported child update before activating implementation.
